title: Security Deposit Account Balance Owed and Collections Schedule
content:
When the deposit does not cover a former resident's move-out charges, the remainder is a balance owed on the Security Deposit Account. This schedule sets, for every deposit program, when a balance owed is due, when it may be referred to collections, what the referral takes with it, and the small-balance write-off amount.

| Term | Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan | Reduced Deposit Plan | Standard Deposit Plan | Premier Residence Deposit Plan | Conditional Approval Deposit Plan | Enhanced Deposit Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Balance owed due (calendar days after the final account statement) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Referral to collections, calendar days after the due date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Unpaid ledger balances referred together with the balance owed | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Small-balance write-off: balance owed at or below this amount is written off instead of referred (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |

### Points of reading

- **Due date.** A balance owed is due 30 calendar days after the statement date.
- **Referral.** Referral to collections is measured 30 calendar days from the due date.
- **Write-off boundary.** The write-off figure is inclusive. A hypothetical balance of exactly 25.00 USD is at the figure and is written off. A balance of 25.01 USD is above it.
- **What a referral carries.** On every program, a referral also takes the ledger balances left unpaid after final accounting.
